## RCA confirmed on current origin/main (23591dc0)

**Proven mechanism.** `infra/scripts/autodeploy.sh:record_mcp_backoff_failure()` (now ~L668) unconditionally calls `err deploy_failed "component=mcp ..."`, and `err()` (~L239) emits an `AUTODEPLOY_ERROR {...}` marker. It is invoked on the TWO documented-routine backoff paths:
- low-memory abort (~L898-899): `marker AUTODEPLOY_MCP_MEM_ABORT ...; record_mcp_backoff_failure; exit 1`
- port-exhausted retire-cap (~L907-908): `marker AUTODEPLOY_MCP_RETIRE_CAP ...; record_mcp_backoff_failure; exit 1`

`observability.sh` counts `^AUTODEPLOY_ERROR \{` markers into `rebar/host:deploy_errors` (~L232/242) and explicitly documents (~L284-291, L355) that the retire-cap/mem-abort tokens are "each kept out of AUTODEPLOY_ERROR so a routine retire-cap / memory abort never inflates deploy_errors" — the sustained case has its own `mcp_retire_cap` / `mcp_mem_abort` alarms. The code contradicts its own contract, false-paging `rebar-autodeploy-errors`.

**Discriminating proof (runtime).** New test `test_port_exhausted_routine_backoff_does_not_inflate_deploy_errors` driving the real script with both blue/green ports held shows the journal emitting BOTH markers for one event:
```
AUTODEPLOY_MCP_RETIRE_CAP {"reason":"port-exhausted", ...}
AUTODEPLOY_ERROR {"reason":"deploy_failed","detail":"component=mcp ... fail#1 backoff=60s"}
```
The retire-cap marker (liveness anchor) fires AND deploy_failed fires — reproducing the live 2026-08-30 incident. Genuine-failure paths (mcp-unhealthy etc., ~L760-991) are unaffected and still emit `deploy_failed` (existing `test_mcp_failure_keeps_the_deploy_failed_metric_and_names_the_component`).

**Classification: `defect`** — violates the cited authoritative contract in observability.sh (same file family, standing intent). Not a design decision.

**Defect origin (caused_by): `6964-40bb-46c9-48a7`** (panicky-sylphish-foxterrier, "infra: add mcp blue-green autodeploy target", commit `2a0a4b19f2ab`, 2026-08-25). That single commit introduced BOTH the observability.sh "kept out of deploy_errors" contract AND the autodeploy.sh routine paths that call the deploy_failed-emitting recorder (`record_backoff_failure` then, `err deploy_failed` inside) — an internally-inconsistent plan. `d2eed2c4e8d7` ("per-component deploy state") only renamed the recorder to `record_mcp_backoff_failure` on those lines; it is a carrier, not the origin. Close class: **plan_defect**.

**Fix (Phase 2):** factor the backoff-timer bookkeeping (write `$MCP_BACKOFF_FILE` + prune) out of the `err deploy_failed` emission via a `schedule_mcp_backoff` helper; add a `record_mcp_routine_backoff` variant (schedule + log, no `err`) for the two routine paths. Genuine-failure paths keep calling `record_mcp_backoff_failure` (schedule + `err deploy_failed`). Throttle (AC #4) preserved on all paths.

## /rebar-debug complete — landed & closed

**Root cause (confirmed on current origin/main).** `infra/scripts/autodeploy.sh:record_mcp_backoff_failure()` unconditionally called `err deploy_failed "component=mcp ..."` (→ `err()` emits an `AUTODEPLOY_ERROR {...}` marker → `observability.sh` counts `^AUTODEPLOY_ERROR \{` into `rebar/host:deploy_errors` → pages `rebar-autodeploy-errors`). It was invoked on the TWO documented-routine backoff paths: low-memory abort (after `AUTODEPLOY_MCP_MEM_ABORT`) and port-exhausted retire-cap (after `AUTODEPLOY_MCP_RETIRE_CAP`). This contradicts `observability.sh` (~L284-291, L355), which documents those tokens as "each kept out of AUTODEPLOY_ERROR so a routine retire-cap / memory abort never inflates deploy_errors" (sustained case covered by dedicated `mcp_retire_cap`/`mcp_mem_abort` alarms). Internally-inconsistent plan → `plan_defect`; introduced by commit `2a0a4b19f2ab` (ticket 6964), which shipped both the contract and the violating code.

**RED evidence.** New `test_port_exhausted_routine_backoff_does_not_inflate_deploy_errors` drove the real script with both blue/green MCP ports held and observed BOTH markers for one event — `AUTODEPLOY_MCP_RETIRE_CAP {...}` AND `AUTODEPLOY_ERROR {"reason":"deploy_failed", ... fail#1 backoff=60s}` — reproducing the live 2026-08-30 incident. Failed for the right reason (routine path emitting deploy_failed) before the fix; GREEN after.

**Fix.** Factored the backoff-timer bookkeeping (write `$MCP_BACKOFF_FILE` + prune, set throttle globals) out of the error emission into `schedule_mcp_backoff()` (no `err`). `record_mcp_backoff_failure()` now = `schedule_mcp_backoff` + `err deploy_failed` (genuine failures still page). Added `record_mcp_routine_backoff()` (schedule + log, NO `err`) and switched the two routine call sites to it. Genuine-failure paths (build/tag/run/unhealthy/handshake/flip) unchanged — still emit `deploy_failed`. Throttle preserved on all paths (AC #4). Net +24/-8 in the script; 2 new tests + helper.

**Step-7 sibling census.** Over-cap retire-cap sweep already marker-only (correct); `config_manual` is a genuine operator-action error (correct to page); `deploy_errors` has a single producer (`err`). No other routine backoff path mis-emits `deploy_failed`. One observed-but-out-of-scope quirk noted: the store-missing path uses the review-bot recorder (`record_backoff_failure`, `$BACKOFF_FILE`) for an mcp failure — harmless (genuine failure, still pages), left unchanged.

**Validation.** `make lint` (incl. shellcheck) + `make typecheck` clean locally. Gerrit change **2421** — `LLM-Review +1` AND `Verified +1` (full CI matrix: macos + ubuntu py3.11/3.12/3.13 pytest, lint+type-check, mutation, packaging all green) — **MERGED**. Closed with `--class=plan_defect --caused-by=6964-40bb-46c9-48a7`.

**File-cluster serialization.** Landed FIRST and cleanly in the `autodeploy.sh` backoff-recording cluster (no textual conflict; Rebase-If-Necessary submitted server-side). The held-back sibling `prespinal-gem-kinkajou` (dbf0) can now rebase onto this. Overlap-flagged `e1d9` (handshake gate) was already in origin/main and edits disjoint lines — no dependency added.

**Residual / deploy-window live verification.** The end-to-end alarm behavior (a real landing burst holding both MCP ports → `rebar-autodeploy-errors` stays quiet while `rebar-autodeploy-mcp-retire-cap` carries the sustained signal) can only be fully confirmed on a live deploy burst. The regression tests assert the observable marker contract that drives those metrics; recommend a spot-check of `deploy_errors` vs `mcp_retire_cap` on the next natural landing burst.

compiled_state.description:
## Summary
The MCP blue-green autodeploy emits `AUTODEPLOY_ERROR {reason: deploy_failed}` (→ `rebar/host:deploy_errors`, which pages the `rebar-autodeploy-errors` alarm) on TWO conditions that are *documented as routine, non-error backoffs that must be kept OUT of deploy_errors*: `port-exhausted` (retire-cap) and low-memory abort. This false-pages the general "deploys are failing" alarm during a normal landing burst, when the deploy is in fact correctly, safely deferring.

## Evidence (live, 2026-08-30 ~03:33–04:05 UTC on i-00880b2c7f13527c5)
During a burst of merges, both blue/green MCP ports (8092/8093) were held by un-reaped containers still in their 21-min graceful drain (`docker stop --time 1260`). Each deploy tick logged BOTH markers for the same event:
```
AUTODEPLOY_MCP_RETIRE_CAP {reason: port-exhausted, ...}
AUTODEPLOY_ERROR {reason: deploy_failed, detail: component=mcp target=... fail#1..4 backoff=60s..480s}
```
`rebar-autodeploy-errors` (deploy_errors, Sum>0 / 4 periods) and `rebar-autodeploy-mcp-retire-cap` BOTH went ALARM. It self-resolved (~04:15). No outage — MCP served the old build throughout; only the cutover was delayed.

## Root cause
`infra/scripts/autodeploy.sh`: `record_mcp_backoff_failure` (~L668) calls `err deploy_failed "component=mcp ..."` → emits `AUTODEPLOY_ERROR` → inflates `deploy_errors`. It is invoked on the two routine backoff paths — low-mem abort (~L915, after `AUTODEPLOY_MCP_MEM_ABORT`) and port-exhausted (~L924, after `AUTODEPLOY_MCP_RETIRE_CAP`). This contradicts the documented contract in `infra/scripts/observability.sh` (~L284-291, L355): the retire-cap and mem-abort markers are "each kept out of AUTODEPLOY_ERROR so a routine retire-cap / memory abort never inflates deploy_errors." The sustained case is already covered by the dedicated `mcp_retire_cap` / `mcp_mem_abort` alarms. Introduced by the blue-green commit `2a0a4b19f2ab` (ticket 6964), which shipped both the contract and the violating code — an internally-inconsistent plan (`plan_defect`).

## Standing intent — this is a fix, not a behavior decision
The intended behavior is documented in observability.sh. The code simply doesn't match it. No ADR / design decision required.

## Fix
Factor the backoff-timer bookkeeping (write `$MCP_BACKOFF_FILE` + prune) out of the `err deploy_failed` emission via a shared `schedule_mcp_backoff` helper. Add a `record_mcp_routine_backoff` variant (schedule + log, no `err deploy_failed`) and switch the two routine paths to it. Genuine-failure paths (build/tag/run/unhealthy/handshake/flip) keep `record_mcp_backoff_failure` and still page. The throttle still applies on all paths.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] A routine `port-exhausted` (retire-cap) backoff does NOT emit `AUTODEPLOY_ERROR/deploy_failed` and does NOT increment `deploy_errors`; the `AUTODEPLOY_MCP_RETIRE_CAP` marker + `mcp_retire_cap` metric remain the signal.
- [x] A routine low-memory abort likewise does NOT inflate `deploy_errors`; `AUTODEPLOY_MCP_MEM_ABORT` + `mcp_mem_abort` remain the signal.
- [x] GENUINE MCP deploy failures (build-failed, tag-failed, run-failed, unhealthy, handshake, flip) STILL emit `deploy_failed` and page `deploy_errors` (no regression to real-failure alarming).
- [x] The mcp backoff throttle (timer/prune) still applies on the routine paths so ticks don't hammer during a drain — only the erroneous deploy_errors emission is removed (the `mcp-deploy-backoff` file is still written).
- [x] A regression test asserts the observable outcome: the retire-cap/mem-abort paths emit their own marker but NOT `AUTODEPLOY_ERROR`, while a real failure emits `AUTODEPLOY_ERROR`.

## Testing
- `python -m pytest tests/scripts/test_autodeploy_mcp_bluegreen.py` — includes new `test_port_exhausted_routine_backoff_does_not_inflate_deploy_errors` and `test_low_memory_routine_backoff_does_not_inflate_deploy_errors` (assert routine marker present, no `AUTODEPLOY_ERROR/deploy_failed`, throttle file still written), plus existing `test_mcp_failure_keeps_the_deploy_failed_metric_and_names_the_component` and `test_unhealthy_new_container_leaves_old_upstream_current` (genuine failures still emit `deploy_failed`).
- Verified: `make lint` (shellcheck), `make typecheck`, `make test` all green. Mutation check: reintroducing `record_mcp_backoff_failure` on the routine sites returns both new tests to RED.

## Notes
Checked for duplication against the blue-green target ticket (6964) and the graceful-drain-contract bug (b580) — not duplicates. The plan-review overlap detector flags shared artifact `record_mcp_backoff_failure` with e1d9 (handshake gate, already landed in origin/main) and the held-back sibling `prespinal-gem-kinkajou` (dbf0); this change edits disjoint lines (function def + the two routine call sites) and lands first in the autodeploy.sh cluster.
